profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA. It trades under the ticker IBM and reported revenue of 67535000000 USD for the period ending 2025-12-31 in a 10-K filing. Its site presents IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform that manages risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated solution, available on any cloud or on-premises, with modular components organizations can deploy as needed. The site states that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment.

The company's tracked AI products center on governance and risk. IBM OpenPages with Watson is described as a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. IBM watsonx.governance covers AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators, and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is described as an enterprise AI platform, with watsonx.governance providing agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection, and as model-agnostic. The site also describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects, and cites a partnership with Citi to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning.

Among the held facts, IBM has recorded law exposure in New York, with a count of 459.
